company.name: Crosby
company.shortDescription: Crosby is an AI-powered legal services company that accelerate contract review and negotiation processes.
company.description: Crosby is an AI-powered legal services company that operates as a hybrid law firm combining artificial intelligence with human lawyers to accelerate contract review and negotiation processes. It focuses on helping fast-growing businesses handle high-volume commercial agreements such as MSAs, DPAs, and NDAs more efficiently. The platform allows users to submit documents through tools like Slack or email, where AI agents perform initial analysis and drafting before lawyers validate the results. This “human-in-the-loop” approach ensures both speed and legal accuracy, often reducing review times from weeks to under an hour. By offering fixed, per-document pricing instead of traditional billable hours, Crosby aims to streamline legal workflows and help companies close deals faster.

productsAndServices.description: A service that uses AI combined with lawyer oversight to review contracts such as MSAs, DPAs, and NDAs within hours, providing fixed pricing per document.
productsAndServices.name: Lawyer-assisted AI Contract Review
